project.title: Original Research-to-Storyboard Micro Explainer
project.creative_brief: Create a materially new micro explainer showing scattered research becoming a clear original production plan.
global_negative_constraints: Do not use the source video, its frames, or its exact color sequence
No recognizable people, third-party logos, trademarks, copied dialogue, music, or pseudo-text

beats.observable_evidence: The reviewed synthetic source holds one stable full-frame visual state during its opening section.
beats.reusable_mechanism: A quiet, stable opening state gives a later visual transition clear contrast.
beats.original_adaptation: Small abstract research-note fragments drift in a charcoal workspace before any structure appears.

prompt.scene: An original editorial workspace built only from abstract paper shapes and soft light.
prompt.visual: Three irregular off-white note fragments float apart on charcoal black with a muted teal edge light.
prompt.action: The fragments drift slowly inward but remain visibly unorganized.
prompt.camera: Centered, calm macro view with a very slow forward move.
prompt.sound: Low paper texture and a restrained tonal bed, no dialogue or melody.
prompt.continuity: Use charcoal, muted teal, and a single warm amber accent; keep the layout text-free.

beats.observable_evidence: The reviewed synthetic source changes to a second stable full-frame visual state.
beats.reusable_mechanism: A sharp but legible state change can communicate organization or progress.
beats.original_adaptation: The note fragments align into three clean evidence cards with visible links between them.

prompt.scene: The same abstract workspace as B01 after an organizing action begins.
prompt.visual: Three evidence cards align on a central vertical axis, connected by thin cyan guide lines.
prompt.action: Each card snaps into place one after another, turning disorder into a readable structure.
prompt.camera: Continue the centered forward move; use one clean visual transition, not a copied cut.
prompt.sound: One soft paper click for each alignment, then a subtle rising tone.
prompt.continuity: Preserve B01's charcoal field, teal edge light, amber accent, and text-free geometry.

beats.observable_evidence: The reviewed synthetic source holds a third stable full-frame visual state through its ending.
beats.reusable_mechanism: A stable resolved state can act as a payoff and leave a clean final impression.
beats.original_adaptation: The evidence cards unfold into a fresh storyboard grid with one warm focal tile, ready for an original production handoff.

prompt.scene: The same workspace after the evidence cards are fully organized.
prompt.visual: A luminous abstract storyboard grid expands from the cards, with one small amber focal tile.
prompt.action: The grid settles into a complete, open composition that suggests readiness to create.
prompt.camera: Finish the gentle forward move on a stable centered frame with breathing room.
prompt.sound: A single clean chime followed by a short natural decay.
prompt.continuity: Keep the B01/B02 palette and geometry; end with no logo, no CTA text, and no watermark.
